sources.title: Kyutai STT
sources.snippet: Kyutai STT is a streaming speech-to-text model architecture, providing an unmatched trade-off between latency and accuracy, perfect for interactive applications. Its support for batching allows for processing hundreds of concurrent conversations on a single GPU. sources.title: stt-1b-en_fr: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview stt-1b-en_fr is a streaming speech-to-text model developed by kyutai that transcribes English and French audio in real-time with a 0.5-second latency. Unlike offline ASR systems that wait for complete audio, this model outputs text as soon as a few seconds of speech become available, making it suitable for live transcription and conversational applications.
